ev.q: PEPFAR-supported programs achieved TPT completion rates up to 87%
Overall, 13,323,186 persons with HIV have completed TPT in PEPFAR-supported programs that report TPT data.
TPT completion rates steadily increased from 56% in FY18 Q2 to 87% in FY23 Q2
The number of persons who initiated TPT increased by an average of 26% between each semiannual period
Overall, 13,323,186 persons with HIV have completed TPT in PEPFAR-supported programs that report TPT data.
TPT completion rates were lower among ART-naive clients compared with ART-experienced clients (79% and 86%, respectively; p<0.01).
Among ART-naive clients, initiation rates were lower among those aged <15 years than among those aged ≥15 years
These TPT completions meaningfully contributed to the 2018 UNHLM target for TPT among persons with HIV
TPT initiation rates peaked in FY19 Q4 (11%)

methods_quotes.q: Mann-Whitney-U tests (α = 0.05) were used to assess stratum-specific differences in TPT initiation and completion rates.
TPT completion rates were calculated as the number of TPT completions in a 6-month period
Analysis of TPT initiation rates among ART-naive clients included only those initiating TPT within 6 months of ART initiation.
TPT initiation and completion rates were aggregated across all PEPFAR-supported programs.
